title: REQ · Scene clears focus when the store focusedObjectId is null
summary: Null store focus removes highlight and label from all objects
description: Context: SceneObject.blur() removes highlight and label. Desired behavior: when focusedObjectId is null (or matches no object), every currently focused SceneObject is blurred, and this runs even before GameState is initialised. Expected result: no object stays highlighted. Why: clearing focus in the store must clear the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given a focused SceneObject and focusedObjectId set to null when the store notifies then its blur() is called
Given focusedObjectId is null and no object is focused then neither focus() nor blur() is called

in_scope: BootScene clearing logic and wiring into onStateChange
preserve: Early return when GameState is null must not skip focus application

technical_constraints: Use SceneObject.isFocused to decide whether to blur
definition_of_done: Null focus clears all highlighted objects
